reuse.why: All providers share the new link guards, and Fintegra reuses bank lookup and sync helpers, although local unlink cleanup remains copied.

duplication.why: The diff repeats guard orchestration across six handlers and duplicates existing account-linking, transaction-download, and unlink-cleanup logic.

placement.why: Provider integration follows the existing module boundaries, but an assertion helper now also performs account mutations.

scope.why: The edits stay focused on the requested linking rules, replacement option, and server-side Fintegra integration.

maintainability.why: Shared guards centralize the rules, but copied workflows and destructive side effects hidden behind an assertion name make future changes harder to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers use the shared guards and bank lookup; the existing unlinkAccount operation includes provider cleanup that replacement explicitly must avoid.

disguised_duplication.where: downloadFintegraTransactions reshapes the existing authenticated transaction-download and response-normalization sequence using a renamed response variable and a more compact request.

abstraction_drift.where: assertAccountIsNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a replacement branch that clears another account's bank fields, turning validation into mutation while retaining its assertion interface.
